data.name: Continuous Load Ammo
data.teaser: You are now able to continuously load or unload ammo outside your inventory!
data.description:
Continuous Load Ammo introduces the ability to load or unload your magazine outside your inventory. Gone are the days of staring at the inventory screen while topping up!

Features

Features

  • Freedom: Walk freely while waiting for your magazines to top up or unload
  • Realism and balancing: The ammo and magazine should only be in reachable places, this includes your vest, pockets, and secure container. Your walking speed will be limited while loading ammo outside the inventory and pulling your weapon out will cancel loading
  • Intuitive controls: You can cancel loading by clicking the left/right mouse buttons. You can quickly load a magazine using a hotkey.
  • Magazine Presets: You can load magazine presets in-raid using the context menu or by using the quick load hotkey. Smart loading process for partially loaded magazines, following the preset from where it left off. Be aware that loading through the inventory screen then closing might cancel loading if the ammo or magazine is not in a reachable place.
  • Quick loading: You can quickly load ammo from outside the inventory by using the hotkey K. By default, this loads your last selected magazine preset in-raid. If none has been selected yet, the best penetrating ammo for your current weapon. While holding this hotkey, mouse scrollwheel up/down to choose which ammo to load into a magazine
  • Configurable: Configuration is available in the BepInEx configuration manager

Reachable Places

  • When loading through the inventory (drag and drop or context menu), reachable places include magazines and ammo in vests, pockets, and secure containers, and also in any nested containers found inside them
  • When using quick load, reachable places include only magazines and ammo inside vests, pockets, and secure containers, NOT including nested containers
Installation

Installation

  • Extract the contents of the .7z archive into your SPT directory.

Recommended Mods

  • Mods that alter loading speed, to balance at your own preference.
  • UIFixes by Tyfon. Load or unload multiple magazines!

Demonstration

Thank you DrakiaXYZ for the gif

Configuration

Configuration

In the configuration manager (F12)

  • The speed limit, as a percentage of the walk speed, set to the player while un/loading ammo. Default is 45%
  • Allow un/loading ammo outside the inventory only when Magazine and Ammo is in reachable places. This includes your Vest, Pockets, or Secure Container. Default is true
  • Do not interrupt un/loading ammo when switching inventory tabs (maps tab, tasks tab, etc.) Default is true
  • Key used to load ammo outside the inventory. Default is K
  • Quick Load Modes:
    • Highest Penetration Available - choose ammo that has the highest penetration power.
    • Last Bullet in Magazine - prioritize the last ammo of the current weapon’s magazine.
    • Last Used Magazine Preset - load the last used magazine preset. If no preset has been selected yet, the best penetrating ammo for your current weapon.
    • Default is Last Used Magazine Preset
  • When using Quick Load, notify the player of the ammo being loaded. Default is true
Support

Known Issues

  • Touching a barbed wire while loading can conflict with the speed limits set by this mod

Support

If you find bugs, or have feature suggestions, feel free to post them on the comment section, or open an issue on GitHub, or most preferably through the SPT Discord, ozen

If you enjoy my work, you can buy me a coffee ☕

Disclaimer: I will not be held responsible for any injuries that may occur, including but not limited to - tripping over obstacles, bumping into walls, falling into a pit, dying from a scav, etc., whilst loading ammo. Please proceed with caution and watch your step.

versions.description:
Added:
- Persist last used magazine preset per caliber

Modified:
- Update to UI Fixes 5.3.5
- More robust handling of UI Fixes Interop

Added:
- Magazine preset fallbacks when no preset is selected, preset is unavailable, or current weapon is not compatible with selected preset

Fixed:
- PP-9 Klin quick load failing
- Keybind detected in stash after entering the hideout
- Scroll wheel down opens the ammo selector while quick load keybind is not pressed

Modified:
- Quick loading while in the inventory screen
- Magazine preset selected in stash reflects in-raid
- Minor optimizations

Added:
- Load magazine presets in-raid

Fixed:
- Quick load hotkey not working in some cases
- Speed limit while loading not properly set

Modified:
- Config to accommodate magazine presets

Added:
- Notification on quick load
- Quick load cancel UI

Fixed:
- Quick load mixing ammo for multi-caliber magazines
- UIFixes compatibility (5.0.6)
- Using food or medicine is stopped after loading is cancelled
- Able to load ammo from unreachable places
- Issues during transit event/raid end

Modified:
- Reachable places logic
- Removed cancel keybind config, now uses shooting keybinds
- Refactor code

Modified:
- Recursive ammo find when using the load ammo keybind

Added:
- Load Ammo Selector: While holding the keybind to load ammo, use the mouse scrollwheels to choose which ammo to load into a magazine

Fixed:
- Using the keybind to load ammo chose the ammo stack with the highest count
- Errors after extracting while loading ammo
- Missing magazine image on some types of magazines

Modified:
- Create own instance of UI elements for reuse, instead of cloning/instantiating everytime
- Removed display UI config options

Added:
- Load ammo outside the inventory using a keybind
- Tyfon's UIFixes MultiSelect compatibility
- Do not interrupt un/loading ammo when switching inventory tabs

Modified:
- Refactored code
- Switch to player component
- Decoupled UI from component

Fixed:

- Immediately cancels loading ammo after closing the inventory in some instances

Added:

- Weapon ammo top-loading support (Mosin, SKS, etc.) and config

Fixed:

- Softlocks caused by UI elements being null
- Able to continue loading ammo when weapon is pulled out
- Entering and exiting bush speed limit conflicts

Notes: Apologies for the raids lost caused by soft locks.
